# Compressonator CMP_Core

Subset of [GPUOpen-Tools/compressonator](https://github.com/GPUOpen-Tools/compressonator) V4.6.0
(commit 095a143ad8cfbf9ed5afa4ea63c735bfd0fd04dd): `cmp_core` and `applications/_libs/cmp_math`,
in the upstream layout. MIT, see LICENSE.txt. Built by cmake/KesCompressonator.cmake.

The full repository is ~740 MB, so only this subset is vendored. To update, copy the same
folders from a newer release.
